The '''Saruwen Station system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Aside from the [[Saruwen Station]], the solar system contained a distant purple sun, a ringed yellow gas giant, and a distant nebula which could be observed from the space station.<ref name="XWA_M5_BMBCT" />

==History==
[[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] piloting the [[Sabra]], [[Emon Azzameen]] piloting the [[Andrasta]], and [[Aeron Azzameen]] piloting the [[Otana/Legends|Otana]], provided cover for [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]] and [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin Azzameen]] as they piloted the transport [[Vasudra]] through this system twice on their way to and from an ambush involving a shipment of [[Bacta]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="XWA_POSG_54" />
